description: Figure 5 is a bar chart illustrating the average likes of headlines from different season groups. The horizontal axis contains the categories, labeled "Most similar group of posts," and displays five sequential numerical intervals: (0,90], (90,180], (180,270], (270,360], and (360,450]. The vertical axis represents the value, labeled "Avg. Like #," using a linear scale that ranges from 400 to 600 with tick marks at regular intervals of 50. The chart features five individual, unstacked light blue bars, each corresponding to one of the horizontal axis intervals, and each bar includes a thin black vertical error bar centered at its top edge. The bars are ordered sequentially according to the intervals on the horizontal axis, and no specific visual emphasis is applied to any individual bar. The shortest bar corresponds to the (90,180] category with an approximate value of 500. The tallest bar corresponds to the (360,450] category, reaching an approximate value of 550. The remaining bars have approximate values of 530 for the (0,90] category, 510 for the (180,270] category, and 540 for the (270,360] category.
